(Currently Amended) 1. An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the alignment device is configured to operate in conjunction with a user interface to facilitate user interaction.

(Currently Amended) 18. The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identification is provided to a user interface to assist in user navigation through the documented procedure. 

(Currently Amended) 19. The method of claim 18, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, thereby enhancing user comprehension of the procedure. 

(Currently Amended) 20. The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identification is utilized to guide user actions in real-time. 

(Currently Amended) 21. The method of claim 20, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and the method further comprises the step of providing an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, thereby improving user engagement with the procedure. 

(Currently Amended) 25. The method of claim 17, wherein said computing step computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, thereby personalizing the alignment process to enhance user effectiveness. 

(Currently Amended) 26. The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure for use in aligning with user actions.
